summary: Tracking a flight in 3D now follows the 3D aircraft itself, with its trail drawn at real altitude.
releaseNotes: Following a selected flight in the 3D views keeps the aircraft itself in the middle of the screen, at its altitude.
3D views: the selected flight no longer shows a yellow ground ring and a flat orange icon beside its 3D model.
3D views: the selected flight's trail is drawn in 3D at its recorded altitude and ends at the aircraft model.
